description: This file defines a static class for managing object pooling of Response objects in the Orleans.Serialization.Invocation namespace. It includes methods for retrieving and returning pooled Response<T> instances and uses a nested static class with a generic type parameter.

classes.name: ResponsePool
classes.description: A static object pool for Response<T> objects, providing methods to get and return pooled instances.

classes.name: TypedPool<T>
classes.description: A nested static class managing a ConcurrentObjectPool for Response<T> instances of a specific type T.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a Response<T> instance from the pool.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Returns a Response<T> instance back to the pool.
